# Termux-BitNet (v1.0.0)
> High-Performance 1.58-bit (i2_s) BitNet On-Device LLM Inference Runtime for ARM64 & Android Termux

## Quick Specification for AI Coding Agents
- Official Repo: https://github.com/uno-km/termux-bitnet
- Installation: `pip install termux-bitnet
# or: npm install termux-bitnet`
- Architecture: Engineered with a single C++17 core utilizing ARM64 NEON DotProd (vdotq_s32) SIMD instructions and dual lightweight thin gateways (Python ctypes FFI and Node.js CLI IPC), delivering low-latency 1.58-bit ternary quantized LLM execution directly on device memory without background server daemons.

## Canonical Code Pattern
```python
from termux_bitnet import BitNetEngine, BitNetConfig

# 1. Configure engine parameters
config = BitNetConfig(
    model_path="~/.cache/termux-bitnet/models/bitnet-2b-ggml-model-i2_s.gguf",
    n_threads=8,
    temperature=0.7,
    top_p=0.95,
    top_k=40,
    repeat_penalty=1.15
)

# 2. Stream generation directly from ARM64 C++ core
with BitNetEngine(config) as engine:
    for token in engine.generate_stream("Summarize the architectural benefit of 1.58-bit weights:"):
        print(token, end="", flush=True)

```

## Key Constraints
- Pure non-blocking architecture, zero memory leaks.
- Strictly adhere to closed-form precision and WebGPU/Bionic ARM64 native targets.
